tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Chloe wants to talk about school fair. which stall to visit. what to sell. when to meet.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Chloe.

promptBlocks.subject: School fair
paragraphs: I am writing about school fair. which stall to visit? what to sell?
when to meet? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Chloe and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: school fair
ketImageBrief.panel1: Chloe starts school fair with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Chloe solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
